target.title: fix(synology-chat): stop fabricating send message ids
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Synology Chat outbound sends fabricated a platform message id. After the incoming-webhook `sendMessage`/`sendFileUrl` calls resolve with a bare `true` (`extensions/synology-chat/src/client.ts:96`, `:132` — `Promise<boolean>`, no id in the webhook contract), the adapter returned `messageId: \`sc-${Date.now()}\`` and stamped that synthetic id into the delivery receipt's `primaryPlatformMessageId`, `platformMessageIds`, and `parts` (`extensions/synology-chat/src/channel.ts`). Downstream consumers treat `messageId` as a real platform id (e.g. delivery-pin lookup in `src/infra/outbound/deliver.ts`), so a fabricated id can be acted on as if it were deliverable platform state. This is the same shape as the merged nostr fix #110006, which removed the synthetic `nostr-${Date.now()}` id in favor of an honest send result.

## Why This Change Was Made

The plugin-sdk contract already defines the sanctioned representation for "no platform id": the empty string sentinel. `createEmptyChannelResult` documents that "empty message ids are the legacy 'no platform id' sentinel expected by outbound callers" (`src/plugin-sdk/channel-send-result.ts:55`), and `buildChannelSendResult` normalizes a missing id to `""` (`src/plugin-sdk/channel-send-result.ts:120`). Sibling channels that receive no platform id from their transport (qqbot `extensions/qqbot/src/channel.ts:52`, googlechat `extensions/googlechat/src/channel.adapters.ts:52`) pass an empty `results` array to `createMessageReceiptFromOutboundResults`, producing a receipt with no platform ids and no parts. This change adopts exactly that shape: `messageId: ""` and a receipt built from an empty results array (keeping `threadId` = chat id for routing context only). Note the receipt builder falls back from `messageId` to `chatId` when resolving a part id (`src/channels/message/receipt.ts:17-27`), so passing the chat id alongside an empty message id would have re-laundered the chat id into a fake platform message id; the empty-results form avoids that. Downstream is safe for the sentinel: the delivery-pin path explicitly guards `if (!params.messageId)` (`src/infra/outbound/deliver.ts:1075`), and result aggregation uses truthiness (`deliver.ts:2572`, `:2618`). Scope is limited to the two send paths; no SDK or core changes.

## User Impact

Successful Synology Chat text and media sends now report an empty message id and a receipt with no platform message ids instead of a plausible-looking but fake `sc-<timestamp>` id. Delivery itself is unchanged; only the reported send metadata becomes honest. Operators relying on delivery receipts will no longer see synthetic ids that cannot be resolved on the NAS.

## Evidence

- Precedent: #110006 (merged) removed the identical `nostr-${Date.now()}` fabrication in the nostr adapter.
- Tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/synology-chat` — with the fix, `channel.test.ts` is 40 passed / 41 total, and the full plugin suite shows 120 passed with 3 failures that reproduce identically on unmodified `origin/main` (`5143d909b9`): two setup-wizard prompt failures in `core.test.ts` and `setup status honors the selected named account` in `channel.test.ts` (locale-dependent wizard prompt expectations, unrelated to this change).
- Reverse verification: with only `channel.ts` stashed, the three updated/new assertions fail (`declares message adapter durable text and media with receipt proofs`, `sendText returns an honest empty-id result on success`, `sendMedia returns an honest empty-id result on success`); with the fix restored, all three pass.
- New/updated coverage: `sendText`/`sendMedia` success tests now assert `messageId === ""`, `receipt.primaryPlatformMessageId === undefined`, empty `platformMessageIds`/`parts`, and `receipt.threadId === chatId`; the message-adapter capability proof test asserts the same honest receipt shape for both text and media.
- Typecheck: `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json` — zero errors in touched code; only the 3 pre-existing `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` errors that also occur on clean `origin/main`.
- `git diff --check` clean; `oxfmt --check` clean on both touched files.
- Diff stat: 2 files, +43/-20 (prod `channel.ts` net −6 lines).
